baseline.note: ABU full raster baseline previously proved exact across the 0.4.0 API integration; fresh 0.4.0 blank variants also exactly match.

scope: Shared frame/art geometry for ordinary nonland Alpha/Beta/Unlimited. Frozen per-card scan-only normalization; no new colors or text fits. No defaults adopted and no live template or score-generation changes.

normalization.2ed: unlimited-paper-normalization.json material-frozen combined interior policy; outer stock keeps its independent pose

policy: Frozen scan-only poses; shared geometry fit on fixed calibration cohort. Validation reused. Identical intersection of opaque source-only support for before/after; exact alpha perturbation checks exclude illustration influence on the renderer. Reference border windows may retain scan content. Outer-stock targets use outer normalization separately. Exact source-local colors retained; material sampling differences reflect geometry. Correlation is not whole-card accuracy.

contract.policy: Only frame/art rects of ordinary measured nonland ABU faces change. All inputs retain exactly the same source-local colors and asset lists; all other public retro rects remain identical. Synthetic custom-stock, layout, template, modern-style and other-set overrides retain baseline geometry.

decisions: All 18 nonland validation groups improve their native interior mean. These correlations are not a whole-card compliance percentage.

Do not adopt the whole-frame candidate: Unlimited stock correlation regresses in every material because the white-border mask follows the plate transform. Anchor the stock boundary/keyline independently and replay.
Unlimited blue art-top loses more than 0.03 correlation; inspect actual resampling and tune on the frozen calibration cohort before another validation pass.
Alpha artifact right stock, Beta black top stock and Beta green bottom stock also retain explicit regression flags despite improved group means.
All 69 land rasters remain byte-identical. Preserve the rejected land-transform decision from the previous proposal.
Source-local pigment adjustments are exactly unchanged. Beta green and all six Unlimited nonland materials have no active frame calibration in these inputs; this remains a separate color-pass gap.
Validation cards have been inspected in earlier studies. Reuse is explicit; these are not new unseen holdouts.

wholeFaceDiagnostic.policy: Frozen inputs and scan-only interior poses. Full-face metrics sample only the first accepted frozen calibration card per nonland set/material (18 cards); all 899 raster hashes and 69 land controls are checked. Native component regressions already reject this candidate, so no whole-set aggregate rescore is claimed. Whole-raster gradient F1 at one-pixel tolerance, not the component-weighted accuracy score or the final WebGL silhouette/finish. Unverified original wording is retained and explicitly recorded. Reused validation; no per-card renderer fit. All 69 ABU land rasters must remain byte-identical. Eight rejected Alpha/Beta poses are counted, not scored. Printed-stat source differences (including Alpha Elvish Archers) also remain unreviewed; do not infer typography accuracy from this diagnostic.
